info.name: Travel Booking API — Complete Test Collection
info.description:
Complete step-by-step Postman collection for the Node.js Travel Booking API.

Testing Order (run top-to-bottom):
  Phase 1  — Health / Sanity Check
  Phase 2  — User Registration (OTP flow)
  Phase 3  — Authentication (Login, Token Refresh, Password Reset)
  Phase 4  — User Profile & Account
  Phase 5  — Public Catalogue (Locations, Hotels, Packages)
  Phase 6  — Admin Login & Profile
  Phase 7  — Admin: User Management
  Phase 8  — Admin: Location Management
  Phase 9  — Admin: Hotel Management
  Phase 10 — Admin: Package Management
  Phase 11 — Admin: Booking Management & Stats
  Phase 12 — User Bookings
  Phase 13 — Payment (Razorpay)
  Phase 14 — Teardown / Cleanup

How To Use:
  1. Import this file into Postman.
  2. Set the 'baseUrl' Collection Variable to your server (default: http://localhost:3000).
  3. Run the entire collection with 'Collection Runner' in order.
  4. Each request auto-saves tokens and IDs into Collection Variables via Tests scripts.

Variables automatically populated during the run:
  userAccessToken, userRefreshToken, adminAccessToken, adminRefreshToken
  userId, adminUserId, createdUserId
  otpToken, verifiedEmailToken, resetToken
  createdLocationId, createdHotelId, createdPackageId
  createdBookingId, createdBookingMongoId
  razorpayOrderId

request.description: Sanity check — confirms the server is reachable. Expects a 401 (no token supplied) which proves the app is running and routing correctly.
Step 1 of registration. Sends a 6-digit OTP to the user's email and returns an otpToken (JWT) for the next step.

request.description: Step 2 of registration. Submits the OTP received by email + the otpToken from step 1. Returns a verifiedEmailToken (JWT) valid for 15 minutes.
Step 3 of registration. Submits user details + the verifiedEmailToken. The image field is optional. Returns the created user object (no token — user must login separately).
Expects 400 — verifiedEmailToken is mandatory; registration without it should be rejected.
Standard user login. Returns accessToken (1h) and refreshToken (7d). Tokens are saved to collection variables.
Expects 401 — invalid credentials.
Expects 404 — user not found.
Admin-specific login endpoint with its own rate limiter. Returns accessToken and refreshToken for the admin.
Expects 403 — regular user cannot use admin login endpoint.
Uses the refreshToken to get a new short-lived accessToken. Updates userAccessToken in collection variables.
Expects 401 — invalid or expired refresh token.
Initiates the password reset flow. Sends a 6-digit OTP to the user's registered email.
Expects 404 — user not found.
Verifies the OTP from the previous step. Returns a resetToken (hex string) valid for 10 minutes.
Final step of password reset. Requires the resetToken from the previous step. After this, update userPassword variable manually.
